name: manual_15461c
claim: For coordination-board write jobs, same board and same repo are not enough: the board row must name or derive a source_ref and expected_base_sha, and every agent must create a fresh worktree from that exact ref and verify HEAD before editing.

decisions.notes: A Codex/Claude PR260 handoff coordinated on the same board but used different checked-out branches, creating avoidable duplicate splice work. The durable fix is to make source branch and base SHA part of the board job contract before any writes.
